Package com.saicone.settings.type

Interface ListValueType<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the value type itself.
All Superinterfaces:
com.saicone.types.AnyObject<T>
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ListValueType<T> extends com.saicone.types.AnyObject<T>
Represents a value that can be converted into different types of objects.
